tables.name: Moat
tables.description: Modified by Barbican. A trench dug around the fortification.

results.name: Dry Moat
results.description: The moat is not filled with water and is, instead, a deep pit encircling the fortification. This could be purposeful, or the lack of water could be due to drought.

results.name: Dry Moat [Trapped]
results.description: The moat is dry, but filled with some extra defensive measures, such as spikes or vicious animals.

results.name: Filled Moat
results.description: A standard moat, filled with water.

results.name: Filled Moat [Trapped]
results.description: The moat is filled with water and is trapped somehow. Perhaps there is a natural or artificial current, or perhaps it is filled with vicious, aquatic animals.
